en: Vintage postcard showing a monochrome illustration of a large classical theatre building fronting an open square. A few small human figures stand in front of the building. In the upper right corner is a red printed greeting in German, and in the lower right there is a black heraldic lion beside a shield in the colors black‑red‑gold. The caption beneath the image identifies the building as the Franzens theater.
